prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Master Your Desktop Pet Controls", "Quickly review how to interact with and position your companion on screen.", "Right-click pet for main menu & settings", "Drag pet to move across desktop", "Start Playing"]
2: ["Finalize Your Companion's Official Passport", "Companion Name", "Verified Desktop Companion"]
3: ["Preparing Your Pet for Desktop Spawn", "Generating 3D animations and desktop overlay modules."]
4: ["Sign In to Restore Your Companion", "Log in to sync your custom pets, unlocked items, and desktop preferences.", "Your existing pet data and adoption history will be safely restored."]
5: ["Upload a bright, well-lit frontal picture for best AI rendering results.", "High Clarity Recommended"]
6: ["Did you know? You can feed and pet your companion directly on your desktop taskbar."]
7: ["Choose Your Path & Claim 100 Free Pet Treats", "Select how you want to create your companion and receive a welcome gift bonus.", "+100 Free Starter Treats"]
8: ["Your Pet is Ready to Walk on Your Desktop!", "Click below to bring your new companion directly onto your screen.", "Spawn Desktop Pet"]
9: ["Welcome to Your Virtual Desktop Companion", "Bring living, interactive digital friends right onto your screen desktop."]
